name: Siddheswari Garments Ltd
about: Incorporated In 1994, Siddheswari Garments Ltd does trading activities and invests liquid funds[1]
keyPoints:
Operational Status:[1][2]
a) SGL's main business activity was manufacturing and selling of knitted hosiery garments, under the brand name Siddeshwari, to cater to the domestic market. But due to continued labour unrest at the manufacturing unit, the company was forced to close down its production activities
b) Company is pursuing sporadic Trading operation and dealing in derivatives and continues with trading activities and investing its liquid funds. 
c) Company is also looking for project proposals to commence new ventures

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 0.01% over last 3 years.
